brief:
Jerusalem District Electricity Company announced it will cut power to several areas in Ramallah and Bireh governorate, the Ma'an news agency reported. The company said the outage is scheduled for Monday, October 12, 2026, from 8:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m.

The power cuts affect multiple neighborhoods in the two Palestinian cities as part of scheduled maintenance or load management by the utility.
dek: Jerusalem District Electricity Company announced it will cut power to several areas in Ramallah and Bireh governorate, the Ma'an news agency reported.
title: Jerusalem power company cuts electricity to Ramallah, Bireh areas
